q: What makes up the weekly agent routine?
options: A repeating reminder for a set day, time and job, then you run it
Asking the AI to remind you every hour
explanation: The routine is free and works on any phone: a repeating reminder fixes the day, time and job, and you start the run yourself. No scheduling feature is needed.

q: What does the Day 10 share challenge ask you to do?
options: Send a promotional message to your entire contact list
Show one real output to one person who needs it, plus the free Day 1
Post your certificate on social media every day for a week
Promise people they will earn money from AI
explanation: The share step is simple: one real output, one person who needs it, plus the free Day 1. There are no spam scripts or pressure tactics, because pushy sharing looks like a scam and stops word of mouth.

q: How is the course's honesty rule kept in the share step and the certificate?
options: No income promises or spam, and the certificate covers only completion and submissions
Learners must recruit five people each
The share step is optional but heavily paid
explanation: The course makes no promises of income, employment or placement. The certificate confirms only that you completed the ten days and submitted your Playbook and agent file.

q: What does the lesson say about where this road leads?
options: Phone agents are the final destination of AI
Phone agents have a limit; fully autonomous agents belong to a separate advanced course, if you want it later
Learners must upgrade immediately to keep their certificate
explanation: The phone-based methods taught here wait for you to start them. Agents that run on their own computer belong to a separate, more advanced course on computer-based agents, for anyone who wants it later. Nothing in this course requires it.
